next_external_step: Keep the game at its main menu. Establish the independent Windows SSH tunnel with reverse mapping 127.0.0.1:18526:127.0.0.1:21526 and dashboard forward 8765, keep the terminal open, then notify the assistant to verify Linux GET responses and BridgeClient protocol/fingerprint checks. Windows root and main-menu HTTP have succeeded; do not reinstall or change ports again. No gameplay action yet.
completion_rule: Do not mark complete until original-game behavior and declared supported scenario parity have been verified. Simulator-only tests do not prove local game parity.
limitations: User reports main-menu v0.107.1 / 2026.06.18; the live Windows main-menu response now reports a DLL fingerprint matching received references. DLL metadata remains generic 0.1.0.0; the semantic release is not independently measured by this HTTP response, and the acceptance version gate remains unresolved.

Windows port 21526 configuration and main-menu HTTP success are supported by user terminal responses with protocol/fingerprint checks. Linux tunnel access, combat observation/action/result and original-game parity remain unverified.
Comparison coverage excludes catalog-derived card values and hidden RNG; a matching finite trace never proves global game parity.
Exact original/simulator initial state and RNG alignment still require implementation and live evidence.
Reference replay checks one declared seed and refuses initial-state mismatches; no automatic original-game staging or RNG import is implemented.
